source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of using libraries (PDF 48).

blocks.text: Python mein libraries aur modules toolboxes (auzaar ke dabbon) ki tarah hain: in mein bane banaye tools hote hain, is liye har cheez shuru se khud nahi banani parti. Is hisse mein hum dekhenge ke standard libraries (jo Python ke saath aati hain) aur third-party libraries (doosron ki banayi hui) program mein kaise import aur istemal ki jati hain, Python modules kahan dhoondti hai, aur woh package ki shakal mein kaise rakhe jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Sab kuch khud likhne ki bajaye library kyun istemal karein?
blocks.explanation: Yeh waqt aur mehnat bachati hai aur pehle se tested (aazmaye hue) tools deti hai, is liye aap apni asal problem par focus (dhyan) kar sakte hain.

items: Library/module: bane banaye tools; import se program mein aate hain.
